questions.question: If (1 + 3 + 5 + 7.. 20 terms) _________ (2 + 4 + 6 + .. n terms) = 40 _________ 11 , then find n. If (1 + 3 + 5 + 7.. 20 terms) _________ (2 + 4 + 6 + .. n terms) = 40 _________ 11 , then find n.

questions.solution:
Here the numerator is the sum of first 20 odd numbers which is equal to 202 i.e. 400

Denominator is the sum of first n even numbers which is of the form n2 + n

400/(n2 + n) = 40/11

On solving we get, n = 10

Required numbers are 108, 117, 126...... 999

This is an A.P. in which a = 108, d = 9 and l = 999

Let the number of terms = n.

So a + (n-1) x d = 999

So, n = 100

Required sum = n/2(a + l) = 100/2 x (108 + 999) = 55350
